1800-1900
During the early 1800s there was much tension. Valmornians were bullied on the streets, some were even lynched, while the Kolionian government had not done anything to fix it. Then one person went one step to far. The Kolionian prime minister came to check out Valmorniany, and as we walked through the dirty streets Volmornians watched, then something happened a man pulled out a pistol and shot the minister, killing him. That is considered the first shot of the Valmornian Revolution. Many Valmornians quit their jobs and went to fight, others left for other countries. Valmornians had no experience with the weapons they had, but they knew ho to fight, and that's what they did. Even though Eastornia-Kolionia was strong they beat them out of Valmorniany. They knew they shouldn't stop, but they also knew it'd be impossible to win if they keep fighting, so they officially declare independence and they ask for peace. [nation]Eastornia-Kolionia,[/nation] exhausted of it's resources, reluctantly says yes to peace and yes to Valmorniany being independent. Thus the 1900th century leaves and in it's place the 20th century starts, bringing new hope and new beginnings to Valmornians.
